description: This Java class implements a command strategy for approving loan rescheduling requests within a batch processing framework. It parses URL parameters, invokes the relevant API resource to approve the request, and constructs the batch response accordingly.

classes.name: ApproveLoanRescheduleCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements command pattern to approve loan reschedule requests by parsing request URL, invoking the reschedule API, and preparing a batch response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a batch request to approve a loan reschedule by extracting the schedule ID from the URL, calling the API resource, and assembling the response.
